margin.why: The Morpho app reads its own preview when it builds the transaction, accrued two hours ahead (computeVaultMaxSharePrice and computeVaultMaxShareAllowance in packages/morpho-sdk/src/helpers/slippage.ts at the same commit). The share price moves between this card and then, up with interest or down with a Vault V2 fee, and with the default alone a move against the card makes the app's own transaction MISMATCH. 0.07% more covers about three days of a vault earning 8% a year.

value.free: the Safe's whole share balance, read when the transaction is built; the effects require the Safe to hold no shares afterwards and the allowance to end no higher than it started

trailer.why: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and a 4-byte origin tag, as on multicall; approve reads only its two arguments

calls.function: multicall((address to, bytes data, uint256 value, bool skipRevert, bytes32 callbackHash)[] bundle)

call.function: erc4626Redeem(address vault, uint256 shares, uint256 minSharePriceE27, address receiver, address owner)

shares.free: the Safe's whole share balance; the effects require the Safe to hold no shares of the vault afterwards

trailer.why: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and a 4-byte origin tag, which multicall ignores (morpho-org/sdks, addTransactionMetadata)

calls.merge: the Morpho app puts every vault's withdrawal into one multicall, after all the share approvals
